proposal.summary: OpenSC vulnerability: buffer overrun in pkcs15 cardos_have_verifyrc_package due to incorrect ASN.1 length calculation when scanning for two tags. Causes heap-based out-of-bounds read; may crash with ASAN; potential info leak or further impact.
proposal.cwe_quote: buffer overrun vulnerability in pkcs15 cardos_have_verifyrc_package. The attacker can supply a smart card package with malformed ASN1 context. The cardos_have_verifyrc_package function scans the ASN1 buffer for 2 tags, where remaining length is wrongly caculated due to moved starting pointer. This leads to possible heap-based buffer oob read.

AV.quote: The attacker can supply a smart card package with malformed ASN1 context.

AC.quote: remaining length is wrongly caculated due to moved starting pointer.

C.quote: This leads to possible heap-based buffer oob read.

I.quote: information leak or more damage is possible.

A.quote: In cases where ASAN is enabled while compiling this causes a crash.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Provide a secure fix for ASN.1 length handling in cardos_have_verifyrc_package; add bounds checks to prevent heap-based OOB reads; reproduce with malformed ASN.1 to confirm; enable fuzzing and ASAN/UBSan in CI to catch similar issues.
